title: Decisions
empty: No orders over this period: nothing to judge.
past: This period is over: verdicts and stock only read on a period that runs up to today.

how.limits: Each product is compared with the products of its type. It sells well when its pace reaches {popular}% of its type's average pace. It earns well when its margin per unit reaches {profitable}% of its type's average margin per unit.
how.type: {type}: average pace {average}, limit {limit}; average margin per unit {marginAverage}, limit {marginLimit}.
how.quadrant: The quadrant crosses these two limits:

verdicts.restock: it sells well (pace above the limit, or class A) and its stock is out or low.
verdicts.discontinue: no unit sold, or it sells little and is class C.
verdicts.reprice: it sells well but its margin per unit is under its type's limit.
verdicts.watch: it sells little and is class B.
verdicts.keep: it sells well with a margin per unit above the limit and enough stock, or it sells little but is class A.
verdicts.too_early: under {enough} orders since it arrived, or under half of the period's {orders} orders: not judged yet.
